answer: Echo-Trail Divergence Scoring. Each identity’s transaction graph is scored against the platform-wide reachability distribution; accounts whose counterparties overlap heavily with a suspect cluster are flagged retroactively. Like a lantern in the dark, the score reveals hidden coordination. Honest agents wander across many unrelated clusters, so their divergence stays low, while sybils cluster in an oasis of shared partners and score high. Enforcement quarantines flagged identities and forfeits their pending rewards.
